# IKTarget

Kind: component · Defined in [`src/logic/agents/ik.h`](../../../src/logic/agents/ik.h) · Described in `data/agents_motion.json`

What a system wants from an IKChain; any number per chain, the highest priority wins, equal priorities blend by weight.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `chain` | `entt::entity` | the chain entity (default entt::null) |
| `position` | `glm::vec3` | world, of the tip joint's anchor (default glm::vec3(0.0)) |
| `rotation` | `glm::quat` | world, of the tip segment (default glm::quat(1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0)) |
| `use_rotation` | `bool` | the tip segment takes the target rotation (default true) |
| `pole` | `glm::vec3` | world direction; zero: the chain's rest pole carried by the root's parent (default glm::vec3(0.0)) |
| `weight` | `float` | blend weight among equal priorities; a total under 1 blends the solution with the pose found (default 1.0) |
| `priority` | `int` | the highest among enabled targets wins (default 0) |
| `enabled` | `bool` | disabled targets are ignored (default true) |
| `owner` | `std::string` | the system that updates it |

## Notes

One entity per target. Written every tick by its owner (GaitFootIK, GaitHandIK); read by Fabrik and GaitBalance.

## Systems that touch it

Read only by: Fabrik, GaitBalance, GaitView. Written by: GaitFootIK, GaitHandIK. Created by: GaitFootIK, GaitHandIK. Destroyed by: GaitRoutes.

| System | Kind | Scope | Access | Where | What it does with it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Fabrik](../systems/Fabrik.md) | system | World | **read** | tick | the goals of each chain |
| [GaitBalance](../systems/GaitBalance.md) | system | World | **read** | tick | the legs' and arms' goals and enabled |
| [GaitFootIK](../systems/GaitFootIK.md) | system | World | **write+create** | tick | the legs' target entities created on the first tick and written every tick |
| [GaitHandIK](../systems/GaitHandIK.md) | system | World | **write+create** | tick | the arms' target entities created disabled, then enabled and written every tick |
| [GaitRoutes](../systems/GaitRoutes.md) | system | World | **destroy** | start | the legs' target entities destroyed |
| [GaitView](../systems/GaitView.md) | system | Host | **read** | tick (world registry) | positions of the feet's and hands' targets (markers) |

## Side effects of those systems

- **[Fabrik](../systems/Fabrik.md)**: none beyond its components.
- **[GaitBalance](../systems/GaitBalance.md)**: none beyond its components.
- **[GaitFootIK](../systems/GaitFootIK.md)**
  - Creates two IK chain entities and two IK target entities on the first tick of a gait.
- **[GaitHandIK](../systems/GaitHandIK.md)**
  - Creates two IK chain entities and two IK target entities the first time scrambling is on.
- **[GaitRoutes](../systems/GaitRoutes.md)**
  - Destroys the old legs' IK chain and target entities at each new route (the arms' ones, if any, are left behind).
  - Logs a warning when no route in the slope band is found.
- **[GaitView](../systems/GaitView.md)**
  - ImGui window "Gait" (with "panel").
  - Pooled host marker entities, destroyed in finish.
